277: #===============================================================================
278: # Account for accuracy of move.
279: #===============================================================================
280: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:predicted_accuracy,
281:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
282:     acc = move.rough_accuracy.to_i
283:     if acc < 90
284:       old_score = score
285:       score -= (0.25 * (100 - acc)).to_i   # -2 (89%) to -24 (1%)
286:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "accuracy (predicted #{acc}%)")
287:     end
288:     next score
289:   }
290: )

292: #===============================================================================
293: # Adjust score based on how much damage it can deal.
294: # Prefer the move even more if it's predicted to do enough damage to KO the
295: # target.
296: #===============================================================================
297: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:predicted_damage,
298:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
299:     if move.damagingMove?
300:       dmg = move.rough_damage
301:       old_score = score
302:       if target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] > 0
303:         target_hp = target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute]
304:         score += ([15.0 * dmg / target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute], 20].min).to_i
305:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "damaging move (predicted damage #{dmg} = #{100 * dmg / target.hp}% of target's Substitute)")
306:       else
307:         score += ([25.0 * dmg / target.hp, 30].min).to_i
308:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "damaging move (predicted damage #{dmg} = #{100 * dmg / target.hp}% of target's HP)")
309:         if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") && dmg > target.hp * 1.1   # Predicted to KO the target
310:           old_score = score
311:           score += 10
312:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "predicted to KO the target")
313:           if move.move.multiHitMove? && target.hp == target.totalhp &&
314:              (target.has_active_ability?(:STURDY) || target.has_active_item?(:FOCUSSASH))
315:             old_score = score
316:             score += 8
317:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "predicted to overcome the target's Sturdy/Focus Sash")
318:           end
319:         end
320:       end
321:     end
322:     next score
323:   }
324: )

326: #===============================================================================
327: # Prefer flinching external effects (note that move effects which cause
328: # flinching are dealt with in the function code part of score calculation).
329: #===============================================================================
330: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:external_flinching_effects,
331:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
332:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && move.damagingMove? && !move.move.flinchingMove? &&

334:       if user.has_active_item?([:KINGSROCK, :RAZORFANG]) ||

336:         if battle.moldBreaker || !target.has_active_ability?([:INNERFOCUS, :SHIELDDUST])
337:           old_score = score
338:           score += 8
339:           score += 5 if move.move.multiHitMove?
340:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "added chance to cause flinching")
341:         end
342:       end
343:     end
344:     next score

364: #===============================================================================
365: # Don't prefer a damaging move if it will trigger the target's ability or held
366: # item when used, e.g. Effect Spore/Rough Skin, Pickpocket, Rocky Helmet, Red
367: # Card.
368: # NOTE: These abilities/items may not be triggerable after all (e.g. they
369: #       require the move to make contact but it doesn't), or may have a negative
370: #       effect for the target (e.g. Air Balloon popping), but it's too much
371: #       effort to go into detail deciding all this.
372: #===============================================================================
373: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:trigger_target_ability_or_item_upon_hit,
374:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
375:     if ai.trainer.high_skill? && move.damagingMove? && target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0
376:       if target.ability_active?
377:         if Battle::AbilityEffects::OnBeingHit[target.ability] ||
378:            (Battle::AbilityEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget[target.ability] &&
379:            (!user.has_active_ability?(:SHEERFORCE) || move.move.addlEffect == 0))
380:           old_score = score
381:           score += 8
382:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's ability")
383:         end
384:       end
385:       if target.battler.isSpecies?(:CRAMORANT) && target.ability == :GULPMISSILE &&
386:          target.battler.form > 0 && !target.effects[PBEffects::Transform]
387:         old_score = score
388:         score += 8
389:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's ability")
390:       end
391:       if target.item_active?
392:         if Battle::ItemEffects::OnBeingHit[target.item] ||
393:            (Battle::ItemEffects::AfterMoveUseFromTarget[target.item] &&
394:            (!user.has_active_ability?(:SHEERFORCE) || move.move.addlEffect == 0))
395:           old_score = score
396:           score += 8
397:           PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the target's item")
398:         end
399:       end
400:     end
401:     next score
402:   }
403: )

405: #===============================================================================
406: # Prefer a damaging move if it will trigger the user's ability when used, e.g.
407: # Poison Touch, Magician.
408: #===============================================================================
409: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:trigger_user_ability_upon_hit,
410:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
411:     if ai.trainer.high_skill? && user.ability_active? && move.damagingMove? &&
412:        target.effects[PBEffects::Substitute] == 0
413:       # NOTE: The only ability with an OnDealingHit effect also requires the
414:       #       move to make contact. The only abilities with an OnEndOfUsingMove
415:       #       effect revolve around damaging moves.
416:       if (Battle::AbilityEffects::OnDealingHit[user.ability] && move.move.contactMove?) ||
417:          Battle::AbilityEffects::OnEndOfUsingMove[user.ability]
418:         old_score = score
419:         score += 8
420:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "can trigger the user's ability")
421:       end
422:     end
423:     next score
424:   }

427: #===============================================================================
428: # Don't prefer damaging moves that will knock out the target if they are using
429: # Destiny Bond or Grudge.
430: #===============================================================================
431: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:knocking_out_a_destiny_bonder_or_grudger,
432:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
433:     if (ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware") || ai.trainer.high_skill?) && move.damagingMove? &&
434:        (target.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond] || target.effects[PBEffects::Grudge])
435:       priority = move.rough_priority(user)
436:       if priority > 0 || (priority == 0 && user.faster_than?(target))   # User goes first
437:         if move.rough_damage > target.hp * 1.1   # Predicted to KO the target
438:           old_score = score
439:           if target.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond]
440:             score -= 20
441:             score -= 10 if battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide) == 0
442:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to KO the Destiny Bonding target")
443:           elsif target.effects[PBEffects::Grudge]
444:             score -= 15
445:             score -= 7 if battle.pbAbleNonActiveCount(user.idxOwnSide) == 0
446:             PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to KO the Grudge-using target")
447:           end
448:         end
449:       end
450:     end
451:     next score
452:   }
453: )

455: #===============================================================================
456: # Don't prefer damaging moves if the target is using Rage, unless the move will
457: # deal enough damage to KO the target within two rounds.
458: #===============================================================================
459: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:damaging_a_raging_target,
460:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
461:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && target.effects[PBEffects::Rage] && move.damagingMove?
462:       # Worth damaging the target if it can be knocked out within two rounds
463:       if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
464:         next score if (move.rough_damage + target.rough_end_of_round_damage) * 2 > target.hp * 1.1
465:       end
466:       old_score = score
467:       score -= 10
468:       PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to damage a Raging target")
469:     end
470:     next score
471:   }
472: )

474: #===============================================================================
475: # Don't prefer damaging moves if the target is Biding, unless the move will deal
476: # enough damage to KO the target before it retaliates (assuming the move is used
477: # repeatedly until the target retaliates). Doesn't do a score change if the user
478: # will be immune to Bide's damage.
479: #===============================================================================
480: Battle::AI::Handlers::GeneralMoveAgainstTargetScore.add(:damaging_a_biding_target,
481:   proc { |score, move, user, target, ai, battle|
482:     if ai.trainer.medium_skill? && target.effects[PBEffects::Bide] > 0 && move.damagingMove?
483:       eff = user.effectiveness_of_type_against_battler(:NORMAL, target)   # Bide is Normal type
484:       if !Effectiveness.ineffective?(eff)
485:         # Worth damaging the target if it can be knocked out before Bide ends
486:         if ai.trainer.has_skill_flag?("HPAware")
487:           dmg = move.rough_damage
488:           eor_dmg = target.rough_end_of_round_damage
489:           hits_possible = target.effects[PBEffects::Bide] - 1
490:           eor_dmg *= hits_possible
491:           hits_possible += 1 if user.faster_than?(target)
492:           next score if (dmg * hits_possible) + eor_dmg > target.hp * 1.1
493:         end
494:         old_score = score
495:         score -= 20
496:         PBDebug.log_score_change(score - old_score, "don't want to damage the Biding target")
497:       end
498:     end
499:     next score
500:   }
501: )
